answer_1.quote: We demonstrate that NumeroLogic enhances the numerical abilities of LLMs across both small and larger models (up to 7B parameters). This enhancement is showcased through supervised training on arithmetic tasks and its application in self-supervised causal language modeling to enhance general language comprehension.
answer_1.outputs: Generated numerical outputs for arithmetic tasks (e.g., addition, subtraction results) and generated answers for multiple-choice questions in MMLU
